MCCH information can change at specific radio frames that are defined by the **modification period**. Within a modification period, the same MCCH information may be transmitted multiple times based on its repetition period. When the network changes (some of) the MCCH information, it notifies UEs about the change via PDCCH that schedules the MCCH in every repetition period of the current modification period.
